description: Open source previs software in the browser: block a scene, pose characters, author camera moves and cuts, then take the same shots to an AI video model.

latest_release.name: CozyClay v3.2.2
latest_release.body:
A patch for the motion compiler and the agent: faster compiles, holds and automatic legs, arms, gaze and tempo, steadier agent turns, and depth exports that read right.

Export

- A depth video whose frames show no empty background (a backdrop that fills
  the frame, a closed corridor) keeps a readable range instead of going all
  black. (#1090)
- Rigged characters render in their current pose in depth frames and
  `blocking-depth.mp4`, not in the T-pose. (#1094)
- `export.shotVideo` takes `passKind: "depth"` and `depthCurve: "inverse"` for
  an inverse-distance depth curve that keeps close-up relief. (#1096)

Camera

- A rail camera aimed at a rising or falling object follows its height each
  frame instead of one shot-average height. (#1095)
- Agents can hold camera framing. (#1027)

Motion

- Compiles run about 1.5x faster: `pose()`'s bone edits run in WebAssembly,
  with takes the same bit for bit. (#1088)
- Holds, and automatic tempo, knee poles, foot heading, free-arm swing and
  gaze (`set.look`) where the keys leave them out. (#1080, #1081, #1082)
- Two-hand carries hold a box from below at its sides; letting go and
  throwing no longer jump.
- Repair and retime run by default, with QA-guarded key thinning. (#1006)
- MotionBricks transition fills (opt-in), a native mode and the Smart
  Primitive runner, with named poses and fills that hold up in scenes with
  objects. (#1008, #1017, #1023)
- A grasp out of reach says so, instead of blaming the grip. (#1066)

Agent

- Provider failures retry gateway 5xx and honour Retry-After; usage limits
  read as quota; sign-in waits say why they stopped. (#1043, #1044)
- Refusals name the failing field. (#1042)
- Tasks: a main turn that makes no progress ends, the watchdog waits on
  running tools and names a model that did not answer, finished tasks undo
  after a scene round trip, and paused tasks resume instead of refusing.
  (#1002, #1004, #1010, #1051, #1056, #1058)
- Every edited turn is checked, with pictures and relations given to the
  model, and the panel shows the review and the context used. (#1000, #1030)
- A handled prop is staged within reach. (#1066)
- Camera, blocking and review previs workflow. (#1014)

Studio

- Contact sheets show a character behind scene bodies. (#1024)
- An empty cast is allowed; cancelling the file picker no longer counts as a
  refusal. (#1041)
- Pose mode picks the one rigged character; the first-success guide starts
  with Add a character. (#1047, #1048)
- Fixed a playback update-depth loop (React #185) and crashes under page
  translation. (#1045, #1046)
- A slab resting on the deck no longer z-fights with it. (#1075)

CLI

- `cclay live save --out file.cclayproject [--force]` saves the open project
  from the terminal. (#1072)
- `cclay live capture --frames A-B --out-dir DIR` renders a run of frames in
  one session. (#1074)
- `live run`, `cmd` and `tool` take `--args-file <path>` or `--args -`
  (stdin), so large payloads such as GLB data URLs fit. (#1092)
- `asset.import` decodes meshopt and Draco compressed GLB. (#1092)
- `inspect` pages entities with `--limit` and `--cursor`; live captures from
  a hidden Studio tab are refused. (#1070, #1071)
- `shot.set` camera keys document `framing.yaw` and `pitch` as radians.
  (#1093)

Other

- three.js 0.187; MCP SDK 1.32.2.
- Landing page: the shot and the way in on the first screen, a sharper hero
  take, and a daily GitHub star count.

detail.readme:
Make the scene first. Then make it a video.
Open source previs in a browser tab: block the set, move the cast, cut the camera, hand the shot to an AI video model.

Try it in the browser · Quick start · Guide for AI agents · Docs · Changelog · Discord

Top: the greybox blocked in CozyClay. Bottom: the AI video made from it. Same idea, a parkour jump: the blocking holds the timing and the camera.
## Why AI video costs money per take, and one miss means paying again. A text prompt cannot hold a whole scene: where everyone stands, how they move, where the camera is, when it cuts. CozyClay lets you make those decisions first, in 3D, where they are cheap to change. Then the video model gets the shot as a first frame, a greybox reference clip and a prompt that describes the real framing. It follows the blocking instead of guessing. ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Stage
set + cast"] --> M["Motion
compiled + QA"] --> C["Camera
shots + cuts"] --> E["Export
frame · clip · prompt"] --> V["AI video model"] ``` ## Quick start ```bash npx cozyclay ``` That is the whole install. You need Node.js 22.19 or newer and a Chromium browser. You do not need a GPU, Python or a model download. The studio opens at `http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/`. **Updating.** `npx cozyclay` fetches the newest release each time you run it. After `npm install -g cozyclay`, the studio shows a small **Update** chip in the top bar when a newer release is out. **Update now** installs it, and **Restart now** starts the new version in the same terminal; the studio reloads once your project is saved. On Windows the chip gives you the command to copy instead: one-click stays off there by design. `cclay update` does the same from the terminal. `--no-update-check` or `COZYCLAY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` turns the check off for one launch; `cclay update --off` turns it off for good, and `cclay update --on` brings it back. > **Asking an AI agent to set it up?** Give it this repository link. Its instructions are in > [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md). ## What you can do | | | | --- | --- | | **Stage** | Build the set from primitives. Add rigged characters, or capsule stand-ins when nobody needs to move a limb. Fly the view like a 3D editor. | | **Move** | Describe the action. The agent writes a motion spec, and a deterministic compiler in the browser bakes every frame. QA checks collisions, foot slide, reach and hand contact before you see it. | | **Shoot** | Put shots on a timeline, draw dolly rails, look through the lens. Each shot knows the limits of the video model you target. | | **Export** | Keyframe pack (first and last frame, greybox clip, camera, prompt), mp4, depth and normal passes, contact sheet, OTIO cut list. | | **Storyboard** | Prefer stills? A Storyboard project is a row of panels with captions, an animatic and a contact sheet. | | **Undo anything** | Every edit, including each change the agent makes, is one undo step. | ## Direct it with AI The same scene can be driven from three places, live, while you watch the viewport. | Surface | Start | For | | --- | --- | --- | | **Agent panel** | `Cmd/Ctrl+B` in the studio | Chat in the studio. Sign in with ChatGPT or use your own key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, MiniMax, OpenRouter, CLIProxyAPI). | | **MCP server** | `npx -y cozyclay mcp` | Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client. | | **Terminal** | `cclay live status --wait` | Coding agents that drive a running studio, JSON in and out. | ```json { "mcpServers": { "cozyclay": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "cozyclay", "mcp"] } } } ``` ## From source ```bash git clone https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay.git && cd CozyClay npm install npm run dev # http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/ npm test ``` ## Docs | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md) | Install, run and connect, written for AI agents | | [`docs/motion3-agent-guide.md`](docs/motion3-agent-guide.md) | Motion specs, compile and QA | | [`docs/agent-cli.md`](docs/agent-cli.md) | `cclay live`, model providers, sessions | | [`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md) | MCP tools and the live protocol | | [`docs/studio-ui-ia.md`](docs/studio-ui-ia.md) | Every control and where it lives | | [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) | Anonymous telemetry and how to turn it off (`cclay telemetry off`) | | [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) | Contribution rules | ## Guides | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [Greybox to AI video](https://cozyclay.org/greybox-to-video/) | Why a grey blockout is the most reliable input for a video model, and the block-then-generate loop | | [Previs software compared](https://cozyclay.org/previs-software/) | Free, open source and browser-based previs tools side by side | | [Seedance 2.5 camera control](https://cozyclay.org/seedance-camera-control/) | Getting the same camera on every take with a reference clip | | [Camera control for AI video](https://cozyclay.org/ai-camera-control/) | Why camera prompts drift and what the models actually accept | Found a bug or want a feature?
